plan.who: Retail saver - Eastern Province (Dammam / Khobar), Saudi Arabia
plan.style: Physical gold, bought in three parts. Not leveraged, not trading, not in a hurry.

tranches.label: First third
tranches.note: Bought. Don't second-guess it - you are in the market.

tranches.label: Second third
tranches.note: Buy on a drop to $3,400-3,450, or after the 9 Dec Fed meeting if it sells off.

tranches.label: Final third
tranches.note: Q1 2027, or earlier if the Fed signals it has stopped raising rates.

rules: Do not chase above $3,750. Paying up is how you turn a good plan into a bad one.
Stop buying entirely below $3,268. That level means the thesis was wrong - preserve the cash.
Missing a rally is not a loss. Buying the top is.
buying_notes: Buy 999 bars or coins, not jewellery. Jewellery charges you for craftsmanship you cannot resell.
Investment-grade gold (99.5%+) is VAT-zero-rated in Saudi Arabia. Confirm it before paying - do not accept 15% VAT on investment bars.
Use established Dammam / Khobar dealers and keep every invoice. You need them to resell cleanly.
The riyal is pegged to the dollar, so the dollar price above is your price. There is no currency bet here.

ksa.label: Saudi Arabia
ksa.note: Investment bars and coins 99.5%+ are VAT-zero-rated. Jewellery is not - you pay 15% VAT plus a making charge you cannot resell.

india.label: India
india.note: Indian retail sits above the world price: roughly 6% import duty plus 3% GST. Jewellers add making charges on top.
